name: @powerhousedao/reactor-mcp

tools.name: getDocumentModels
tools.description: List the document model types this reactor can create and edit.

tools.name: getDocumentModelSchema
tools.description:
Read a document model's schema. Without options it returns the operation names per module.
Pass "compact" before addActions for every action's type, scope and input definition, and the types those inputs use.
Pass "operation" for one action's input schema (GraphQL SDL), "state" for a state schema, or "filter" for a JSONPath over the latest specification.

compact.description: Return every action's type, scope and input definition

operation.description: Action type whose input schema to return, e.g. SET_MODEL_NAME

state.description: Scope whose state schema to return

filter.description: JSONPath over the latest specification, e.g. $.modules[*].name

tools.name: getDrives
tools.description: List the drives: id, type and name.

tools.name: getDrive
tools.description: Read a drive by id or slug, including its folder and file nodes. Pass a filter such as $.global.nodes[?(@.kind=='file')] to narrow it.

documentId.description: ID or slug of the drive to read. Required.

filter.description: JSONPath over the document state, e.g. $.global.items[?(@.status=='OPEN')] or $.global.items[-1]

tools.name: getDocuments
tools.description: List the documents in a drive (its children): id, type and name.

documentId.description: ID or slug of the drive whose documents to list. Required.

tools.name: getDocument
tools.description: Read a document by id or slug: header essentials and its global and local state. Long arrays and strings are cut; pass a filter to read a part in full (up to 100,000 characters).

documentId.description: ID or slug of the document to read. Required.

filter.description: JSONPath over the document state, e.g. $.global.items[?(@.status=='OPEN')] or $.global.items[-1]

tools.name: createDocument
tools.description:
Create a document, optionally inside a drive.
With "driveId" the document is added to the drive as a file, so no separate ADD_FILE is needed.

name.description: Document name, also the drive file's name

driveId.description: Drive id or slug to create the document in

parentFolder.description: Folder id within the drive; only with driveId

tools.name: addActions
tools.description:
Apply actions to a document as one batch. Send several actions in one call rather than one call each.
Besides the model's operations it accepts the base actions SET_NAME, SET_PREFERRED_EDITOR, UNDO, REDO and NOOP.
Every action is validated first; on a validation failure nothing is applied and each failed action is listed.
Returns one result per action, in input order; "success" is false when any result has an "error". An action its reducer rejected is stored as an operation that changes nothing, and the rest of the batch still applies. When a policy denies an action, the whole batch is refused.

documentId.description: ID or slug of the document or drive to change. Required.

type.description: Exact action type from the model's operations, e.g. SET_MODEL_NAME; see getDocumentModelSchema

input.description: Action input, shaped by the operation's input schema

scope.description: Defaults to the operation's scope; rarely needed

tools.name: deleteDocument
tools.description: Delete a document, removing it from its drive first.

documentId.description: ID or slug of the document to delete. Required.

tools.name: getCodegenStatus
tools.description: Vetra's code generation for its documents (document models, editors, apps, processors, subgraphs and the package): each one's state, why it failed or was skipped, and the files it wrote. Vetra regenerates a document's code a few seconds after it changes; call this after addActions on such a document, with `waitSeconds` to wait until it settles, before reading or editing the generated code. `loadFailures` lists the project modules Vetra could not load, e.g. generated code that throws on import.

documentId.description: ID of a Vetra document; omitted, every document's status

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the job, or every job without `documentId`, to be done, failed or skipped. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: addDrive
tools.description: Create a new drive. Pass `name` and, optionally, `icon` and `preferredEditor` at the top level. The older `driveInput` object is still accepted.

preferredEditor.description: App/editor module id recorded as the drive's preferred editor

driveInput.description: Older form of the drive configuration; prefer the top-level fields

preferredEditor.description: App/editor module id recorded as the drive's preferred editor

documentId.description: ID or slug of the drive to delete. Required.
